description: Research Experiences for Undergraduates (REU), NSF NHERI 2025: Scaling Laws for Turbulent Fluid Velocity in Geotechnical Centrifuge Modeling is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Camille Gaz, University of California San Diego (ucsd.edu). This study investigates scaling laws for turbulent fluid velocity through cracks in clay levee models tested within a 9 meter radius geotechnical centrifuge. The intent of this research is to resolve the significant gap in understanding scaling relationships related to turbulent flows. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project with 3 top-level files (PDF). Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-3t9m-rk62. Keywords: similitude, scaling law, centrifuge. Published 2025-08-25. Facility named: Center for Geotechnical Modeling - University of California, Davis. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (labelled "Creative Commons Attribution" on the DesignSafe project). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
